blocking_note: Line owner 2026-11-01 follow-up: E14 records evidence, confidence and disposition for every detection to establish the false-positive rate; it does not block.  The existing acceptance requirements (wrong person, missing plot event, etc.) stay in force unchanged — this trial does not cancel them.  A clearly confirmed serious defect is still handled; an uncertain one is never recorded as a pass.

state_file.absent_behaviour: UNKNOWN for every check — never a failure, never a silent pass

observations.note: No producer writes a per-shot observation file today.  When one does, its rows sit beside the planned state in every report row as OBSERVED; an inconclusive measurement is UNKNOWN.

PROP_HELD_WITHOUT_PICKUP.meaning: prop held in shot N+1, the previous shot has it elsewhere, nothing between them picks it up and it is not INHERITED

PROP_RETAKE_UNDECLARED.meaning: prop PUT_DOWN_IN_SHOT, held again with no declared re-take

ACTION_REPEAT_WITHOUT_STATE_CHANGE.meaning: identical action text and identical state across a pair — propose merging, do not fail

EYELINE_ADDRESSEE_NOT_IN_FRAME.meaning: a gaze addressed at a character while the shot declares nobody in frame

SCREEN_SLOT_CHANGED_WITHOUT_CUT.meaning: a person changes screen slot with no cut, jump cut or declared time/space change to carry the move

TIME_SPACE_CHANGE_UNDECLARED.meaning: the pair crosses a location or a time while declaring SAME_CONTINUOUS

legal_by_construction.off_screen_addressee_with_nobody_in_fram: an eye-line target that is a sentinel or OFF_SCREEN:/OBJECT:/NOBODY is not an addressee
legal_by_construction.over_the_shoulder_occlusion: the target is on screen and occluded_by is declared — occlusion is not absence
legal_by_construction.prop_only_mentioned: a prop named in action text but absent from the props block is not held

wiring.entry_point: lines/nalu/runtime/tools/prompt_batch_qa.py digest — per shot pair, before submission
wiring.granularity: per pair, pure functions, no global pass, no serialisation of unit generation

authorization.quote_followup: Line owner 2026-11-01 follow-up: required as a STEP (the script cannot be marked complete for paid prep without a completed review and the writer's answers to every question; Rule 8 must carry a grounded answer or a NOT_APPLICABLE reason). Creative judgement stays REPORT-ONLY: an AI opinion that a hook is weak, the pace slow or the emotion thin is a revision note in E14, never an automatic veto by score or a single judgement. Cross-shot detections are OBSERVE-ONLY in E14: record evidence, confidence and disposition to learn the false-positive rate; they do not block, and a clearly confirmed serious problem is still handled while an uncertain one is never recorded as a pass.
